g.text: Required before COMMIT: both WANT/REQUEST/RUN low, independently observed quiescence, monitor permits, rails, recording isolation and watchdog valid.

g.text: Then: COMMIT -> read all eight active Q bits -> fresh verification ACK edge -> separate REARM -> assert route WANT -> allow settling before phase.
